# Markstage

> Markstage is a self-hosted visual editor for Astro sites. Writers edit Markdown, MDX and JSON content on the site's real page design, and every save is a clean git diff of exactly what changed (with the Markstage server, a commit by the person who saved). No content database, no cloud. Source-available under the Elastic License 2.0, free to self-host (not open source). Made by Space-O Technologies.

Tagline: Type it. Ship it. Writers edit with Notion-style blocks ("/" for any block, drag by the grip, ⌘K); AI agents draft through an MCP server and publish only when an owner allows it (https://spcaeo.github.io/markstage/ai/). Status: pre-release, in active development. Requires Node.js 22.13 or newer and git.

- Source code: https://github.com/spcaeo/markstage (clone: https://github.com/spcaeo/markstage.git)
- Licence: https://github.com/spcaeo/markstage/blob/main/LICENSE
- Features (61, https://spcaeo.github.io/markstage/features/): writing: Type "/" for any block; Drag blocks by their grip; Find anything with ⌘K; A bar over selected words; Markdown shortcuts as you type; Paste from Word, cleanly; Tables you change in place; The outline of the page; Find and replace; MDX too; The Markdown file itself; A guide inside the editor. pages, sections and media: Edit on the real page; Your site’s own boxes; A Library of parts; Drag a section onto the live page; The section gallery; Alt text right on the image; Images and files in one place; Stock photos, with your own key; Page frames and page types; Authors and co-authors; Translation status; Choices from other systems. team, releases and publishing: A publish sheet that checks; Releases; Share links; Local, staging, production; "Edit this page" on the live site; Every save is a commit in your name; Roles, as WordPress names them; Custom roles; Single sign-on and two-factor; Locks; See who else is editing; Forms in your own inbox; Webhooks and imports. seo and site health: Search checks while you write; Search and social previews; See it on a phone or a tablet; Link suggestions both ways; Link health; Topics and a topic map; Redirects that follow a move; Site check-up. safety and history: A save is a clean diff; Never lose typing; A three-way merge; History of every save; Trash, backups and rollback; An audit log; Previews kept apart. ai and mcp: An MCP server for AI agents; The markstage mcp relay; Publishing by an agent, only if you allow it; Writing help on a selection; Alt text suggestions; Search title and description; Translation drafts; A promotion summary; Your choice of AI provider.

## Docs

- [Writing with Markstage](https://spcaeo.github.io/markstage/docs/writing/): How writers use Markstage: open and start articles, add blocks, save and go live, use the Library, fix links, check SEO and bring back an older version.
- [markstage.config: every key](https://spcaeo.github.io/markstage/docs/config/): Set up an Astro site for Markstage in one file: collections, page URLs, settings fields, frames, page types, topics, forms, media and the editor canvas.
- [Deploying Markstage](https://spcaeo.github.io/markstage/docs/deploy/): Run the Markstage server next to your static site with Docker compose, or with systemd and nginx: data dir, config, the built editor, previews and backups.
- [Markstage with Docker](https://spcaeo.github.io/markstage/docs/docker/): Run the Markstage server image next to your site with one docker run or compose: what happens at start, folders, settings, secrets, updates and tests.
- [The starter site](https://spcaeo.github.io/markstage/docs/starter/): Start a new site from the Markstage starter: a small Astro blog with Markdown posts, an MDX guide and the editor set up, made with one script from a clone.
- [Environments: local, staging, production](https://spcaeo.github.io/markstage/docs/environments/): How Markstage moves content and code between local, staging and production: branches, promotions with checks and screenshots, rules and a shared git remote.
- [Markstage server: security](https://spcaeo.github.io/markstage/docs/security/): How the self-hosted Markstage server protects a content site: sign-in, sessions, two-factor, roles, previews on their own origin, and the test behind each.
- [Markstage API (contract)](https://spcaeo.github.io/markstage/docs/api/): The HTTP API the Markstage editor and server share: sign-in, collections and entries, saves, publishing, media, users, revisions and the error shapes.
- [Editing MDX](https://spcaeo.github.io/markstage/docs/mdx/): How Markstage edits MDX: words typed on the page, components as cards with simple settings, and imports, exports and code kept as written.
- [The MCP server: AI agents](https://spcaeo.github.io/markstage/docs/api-mcp/): Connect an AI agent to Markstage over MCP: it reads the site and drafts as the person whose token it holds, and publishes only if an owner allows it.
- [AI suggestions](https://spcaeo.github.io/markstage/docs/api-ai/): Ask a model for words you then read, change and save: image alt text, search titles and descriptions, summaries, and drafts for other locales.
- [The Library](https://spcaeo.github.io/markstage/docs/api-library/): One store of parts to use again: page templates, sections and snippets, synced or copied, kept as files in the repo, imported from WordPress or a web page.
- [Releases and share links](https://spcaeo.github.io/markstage/docs/api-releases/): Put several changes live together, now or at a set time, with approvals and rules, and share a preview of a release or a draft with people who have no account.
- [Environments API](https://spcaeo.github.io/markstage/docs/api-env/): The server routes and command line behind environments: status, branches on the remote, plans that promote or sync content, and the checks that guard them.
- [Topics and internal links](https://spcaeo.github.io/markstage/docs/api-links/): Markstage keeps a map of every link in the site and suggests fixes both ways, so old pages link to new ones and new pages link to the right older ones.
- [Page frames and page types](https://spcaeo.github.io/markstage/docs/api-page-types/): Two settings a page keeps in its own file: the frame the site lays it out in (full width, reading or plain) and its page type, with the checks each type needs.
- [Authors](https://spcaeo.github.io/markstage/docs/api-authors/): Ghost-style author profiles kept as JSON files in the site content: one per person, linked from posts by slug, with co-authors and an author page each.
- [Custom roles](https://spcaeo.github.io/markstage/docs/api-roles/): Beyond the five built-in roles: a custom role for a translator, a reviewer or an editor who may not upload, limited to collections, locales and fields.
- [Permissions](https://spcaeo.github.io/markstage/docs/api-permissions/): Who may do what in Markstage, by role: owner, administrator, editor, author and contributor, the WordPress names, decided in one place on the server.
- [Single sign-on (OpenID Connect)](https://spcaeo.github.io/markstage/docs/api-sso/): Let people sign in to Markstage with Google Workspace, Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, Auth0, Keycloak or any OpenID Connect provider, with passwords kept or limited.
- [Webhooks](https://spcaeo.github.io/markstage/docs/api-webhooks/): Tell another system when something happens on the site: an entry saved or published, a media file added, the site gone live. Each webhook lists its events.
- [Importing entries and media](https://spcaeo.github.io/markstage/docs/api-import/): Bring entries and media files from another system as JSON: a dry-run plan first, nothing written or fetched, then the run of that plan as one job.
- [Forms, messages and alerts](https://spcaeo.github.io/markstage/docs/api-inbox/): The site forms post to Markstage on your own host: spam checks, limits, team mail and thank-you mail, the Inbox for messages and who hears about which alerts.
- [Translation status](https://spcaeo.github.io/markstage/docs/api-translations/): For a site with several locales: whether each entry’s words are missing, outdated or done in each language, and the list of what still needs translating.
- [Integration fields](https://spcaeo.github.io/markstage/docs/api-integrations/): A Post settings choice whose options come from another system, such as a product catalogue or a CRM’s plans, fetched from a JSON address on a schedule.
- [Preview render](https://spcaeo.github.io/markstage/docs/api-preview/): How Markstage shows a page with unsaved changes on the site’s own dev server, on an origin of its own, so author HTML never runs with the editor’s session.
- [Section gallery and “Edit this page”](https://spcaeo.github.io/markstage/docs/api-edit/): Every section type the site’s pages use, drawn by the site’s own components, and an “Edit this page” link on the live site for people signed in to Markstage.

## Alternatives

- [A WordPress alternative for Astro sites](https://spcaeo.github.io/markstage/alternatives/wordpress/): Moving from WordPress to Astro? Markstage gives writers a WordPress-style editor on your Astro site's real design, with content in git. Checked 3 Nov 2026.
- [A Ghost alternative for Astro sites](https://spcaeo.github.io/markstage/alternatives/ghost/): Markstage vs Ghost for Astro: writers edit on the site's real design, content stays as files in git, self-hosted with no MySQL. Facts checked 4 Nov 2026.
- [A Prismic alternative for Astro sites](https://spcaeo.github.io/markstage/alternatives/prismic/): Markstage vs Prismic: page building, releases and share links with your content in git, self-hosted, no per-repository fees. Facts checked 3 Nov 2026.
- [A Builder.io alternative for Astro sites](https://spcaeo.github.io/markstage/alternatives/builder-io/): Markstage vs Builder.io for Astro: page editing on your site's real design with content in git, self-hosted, no per-user fees. Facts checked 3 Nov 2026.
- [A self-hosted CloudCannon alternative for Astro](https://spcaeo.github.io/markstage/alternatives/cloudcannon/): Markstage vs CloudCannon: both git-based with on-page editing for Astro. Markstage runs on your own server for free. Facts checked 3 Nov 2026.
- [A Contentful alternative for Astro sites](https://spcaeo.github.io/markstage/alternatives/contentful/): Markstage vs Contentful for Astro sites: content as files in your own git repository, edited on the real design, self-hosted for free. Checked 3 Nov 2026.
- [A Decap CMS alternative for Astro sites](https://spcaeo.github.io/markstage/alternatives/decap-cms/): Markstage vs Decap CMS (formerly Netlify CMS): edit on your Astro site's real design, not a form beside a preview. Facts checked 3 Nov 2026.
- [EmDash vs Markstage: which fits your Astro site?](https://spcaeo.github.io/markstage/alternatives/emdash/): EmDash keeps Astro content in a SQL database; Markstage keeps it as Markdown and JSON in git and edits on the real page. Facts checked 3 Nov 2026.
- [A Front Matter CMS alternative for Astro teams](https://spcaeo.github.io/markstage/alternatives/front-matter-cms/): Front Matter CMS runs in VS Code for developers. Markstage gives your whole team a web editor on your Astro site's real design. Checked 3 Nov 2026.
- [A Keystatic alternative for Astro sites](https://spcaeo.github.io/markstage/alternatives/keystatic/): Markstage vs Keystatic: Markstage reads your Keystatic schema, edits pages on the real design and saves JSON byte-identical. Facts checked 3 Nov 2026.
- [An Outstatic alternative for Astro sites](https://spcaeo.github.io/markstage/alternatives/outstatic/): Markstage vs Outstatic: both git-based and free to self-host. Markstage edits on your Astro site's real design and includes roles. Checked 3 Nov 2026.
- [A Pages CMS alternative for Astro sites](https://spcaeo.github.io/markstage/alternatives/pages-cms/): Markstage vs Pages CMS: both edit files in git. Markstage edits on your Astro site's real design and adds roles, staging and forms. Checked 3 Nov 2026.
- [A Payload alternative for Astro content sites](https://spcaeo.github.io/markstage/alternatives/payload/): Markstage vs Payload for an Astro site: editing on the real page with content in git, instead of a Next.js backend and database. Checked 3 Nov 2026.
- [A Sanity alternative for Astro sites](https://spcaeo.github.io/markstage/alternatives/sanity/): Markstage vs Sanity for Astro: visual editing with content as files in your own git repository, self-hosted, no seat fees. Facts checked 3 Nov 2026.
- [A Sitepins alternative for Astro sites](https://spcaeo.github.io/markstage/alternatives/sitepins/): Markstage vs Sitepins: both commit every save to git. Markstage edits on your Astro site's real design and runs on your server free. Checked 3 Nov 2026.
- [A Statamic alternative for Astro sites](https://spcaeo.github.io/markstage/alternatives/statamic/): Markstage vs Statamic: both keep content as files in git. Markstage edits on your Astro site's design with no PHP and no licence fee. Checked 3 Nov 2026.
- [A Storyblok alternative for Astro sites](https://spcaeo.github.io/markstage/alternatives/storyblok/): Markstage vs Storyblok: visual editing on your Astro site with content in git, self-hosted, staging and custom roles included. Facts checked 3 Nov 2026.
- [A Strapi alternative for Astro content sites](https://spcaeo.github.io/markstage/alternatives/strapi/): Markstage vs Strapi for an Astro site: edit on the real page with content in git; releases, roles and SSO with no plan fees. Facts checked 3 Nov 2026.
- [StudioCMS vs Markstage: which fits your Astro site?](https://spcaeo.github.io/markstage/alternatives/studiocms/): StudioCMS is a server-rendered Astro CMS with a database; Markstage keeps content in git and edits on the real page. Facts checked 3 Nov 2026.
- [A Sveltia CMS alternative for Astro sites](https://spcaeo.github.io/markstage/alternatives/sveltia-cms/): Markstage vs Sveltia CMS: both keep content in git. Markstage edits on your Astro site's real design and adds staging and roles. Checked 3 Nov 2026.
- [A TinaCMS alternative for Astro sites](https://spcaeo.github.io/markstage/alternatives/tinacms/): Markstage vs TinaCMS for Astro: edit on your site's real design, keep content in git, self-host free with no database server. Checked 3 Nov 2026.
